desc: Prove that every valid contiguous substring corresponds to consecutive sibling subtrees, and that the operation reverses their order while mirroring each subtree.
Prove reachability of exactly all ordered rooted forests having the same unordered rooted-tree type, including arbitrary sibling permutations and independent recursive rearrangements.
Derive and justify the recurrence \(f(T)=\frac{k!}{\prod m_i!}\prod f(U_i)^{m_i}\), including the virtual root and duplicate child types.
Implement deterministic bottom-up canonicalization, factorial/inverse-factorial arithmetic, and parsing in \(O(N\log N)\) time and \(O(N)\) memory.
Test the implementation against the samples and structural edge cases such as a single chain, many identical siblings, and repeated equal subtree types.
